notes: Auto mode clicks Proton for you, minimize to tray, Proton auto-detect fixed
patch_notes:
Auto mode: GameMode now clicks Proton's own Disconnect and Connect buttons for you (Windows UI Automation) and verifies the result live; the guided steps remain as an automatic fallback.
Minimize to tray: closing the window now hides GameMode in the system tray, still watching; double-click the tray icon to reopen, right-click to quit.
Proton is now found automatically (ProtonVPN.Client.exe in its versioned folder), and the app learns whether your kill switch is in play and shortens the steps when it is not.
